title: Transit staff tentative labour settlement approved
subtitle: Special meeting held a closed session on labour relations, then approved the Unifor Local 4304 agreement.
overview: Regional Council held a short special meeting on May 11, 2023, to deal with a labour relations matter. Council met in closed session, then returned to open session to vote on the outcome.

Council approved a tentative Memorandum of Settlement for the Region's transit staff represented by Unifor Local 4304. The agreement covers May 1, 2023 to April 30, 2026 {{vote:m3}}. Approval matters to residents who rely on transit, because it sets labour terms for the next three years.

In closing remarks, the Regional Chair thanked staff for working toward a deal described as fair to the union and affordable to taxpayers. The Chair also said it includes a phased return of transit service and some free service to help compensate riders. These remarks were not part of a motion. The meeting then passed the confirming by-law and adjourned.

decisions.detail: Council approved a tentative Memorandum of Settlement for transit staff represented by Unifor Local 4304, covering May 1, 2023 to April 30, 2026 {{vote:m3}}.

debate: There was no substantive debate on the motion. Council moved through the recommendation from closed session and voted, with several members taking part by phone or by showing hands because of technical issues.
In closing remarks, the Chair said staff worked to reach a deal that was fair to the union and affordable to taxpayers.
The Chair also pointed to a phased-in resumption of transit service and some free service to compensate riders, and said the outcome matters to residents who rely on transit.
